title: mUnit lint config (munit-lint.json)
description: Which rules apply, which files are linted, and per-file overrides of rule levels. Configs cascade: every munit-lint.json in a file's folder and the folders above it applies, outermost first, up to one with "root": true. Paths are relative to this file's folder. See "Linting patchers" in the mUnit README.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for editor completion: the path of lint-rules/config.schema.json in the mUnit package, relative to this file.

rules.description: The rules in force: built-in sets ("mUnit:recommended", "mUnit:tests"), rule files or globs relative to this file ("./lint-rules/*.json"), and rules written inline. Default ["mUnit:recommended"]. A rule with an id already seen in an outer config replaces it.

oneOf.description: A built-in set ("mUnit:recommended", "mUnit:tests"), or a rule file or glob relative to this file.

files.description: Which files are linted, as globs relative to this file. Default: every .maxpat, .maxhelp, .gendsp and .rnbopat. An inner config's list replaces an outer one's.

ignore.description: Files that are never linted, as globs relative to this file. Each config's patterns add to the outer ones.

overrides.description: Per-file rule levels, applied after the outer configs' overrides; later entries win.

files.description: Which files the override applies to, as globs relative to this file. Left out: every file under this config.

rules.description: Rule ids and the level each gets for these files.

additionalProperties.description: What a finding does: "warn" is reported, "block" is reported and makes `munit lint` exit 1 (fails CI), "off" turns the rule off. Default "warn".

root.description: true: stop looking for configs in the folders above this one, so nothing outside the project changes its results. Default false.
